CREATE TABLE "public"."refund" (
  "amount" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "cancelledAt" timestamptz,
  "completedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "failedAt" timestamptz,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "method" text,
  "note" text,
  "orderId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "processedAt" timestamptz,
  "processedById" int4,
  "reason" text,
  "refundNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "returnId" int4,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "refund_method_check_e3050dc7" CHECK ("method" IN ('CASH', 'BANK_TRANSFER', 'MOBILE_BANKING', 'ORIGINAL_PAYMENT_METHOD', 'OTHER')),
  CONSTRAINT "refund_status_check_c85a3565" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."refund_status_history" (
  "changedById" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "fromStatus" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "note" text,
  "refundId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "toStatus" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "refund_status_history_fromStatus_check_56975dbf" CHECK ("fromStatus" IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')),
  CONSTRAINT "refund_status_history_toStatus_check_8187a37d" CHECK ("toStatus" IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."return" (
  "adminNote" text,
  "approvedAt" timestamptz,
  "cancelledAt" timestamptz,
  "completedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customerNote" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "orderId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "receivedAt" timestamptz,
  "rejectedAt" timestamptz,
  "requestedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "returnNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'REQUESTED' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "return_status_check_6ffe6862" CHECK ("status" IN ('REQUESTED', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'IN_TRANSIT', 'RECEIVED', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."return_item" (
  "adminNote" text,
  "condition" text,
  "customerNote" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "orderItemId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "reason" text NOT NULL,
  "restockQuantity" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "restockStatus" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "returnId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "return_item_condition_check_775c8094" CHECK ("condition" IN ('UNOPENED', 'GOOD', 'DAMAGED', 'DEFECTIVE', 'USED')),
  CONSTRAINT "return_item_reason_check_e9e2f3b2" CHECK ("reason" IN ('DAMAGED', 'DEFECTIVE', 'WRONG_ITEM', 'NOT_AS_DESCRIBED', 'SIZE_OR_FIT', 'CHANGED_MIND', 'OTHER')),
  CONSTRAINT "return_item_restockStatus_check_05294ac9" CHECK ("restockStatus" IN ('PENDING', 'RESTOCKED', 'NOT_RESTOCKABLE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."return_status_history" (
  "changedById" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "fromStatus" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "note" text,
  "returnId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "toStatus" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "return_status_history_fromStatus_check_4f355bbd" CHECK ("fromStatus" IN ('REQUESTED', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'IN_TRANSIT', 'RECEIVED', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED')),
  CONSTRAINT "return_status_history_toStatus_check_158cd2f5" CHECK ("toStatus" IN ('REQUESTED', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'IN_TRANSIT', 'RECEIVED', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED'))
)
